description.en: Cynognathus crateronotus: whole living environment prop. Nominal whole 1m is artistic asset scale. NHM actual C.crateronotus skull and jaw anchors deep elongated head, cheek mass and small canine hints; no pictured specimen accession supplied or invented. Field Museum Learning Center page35 whole artwork by Velizar Simeonovski 2018 anchors broad body posture; it is interpretive art not a complete fossil scan. Fur, color, soft tissue, auricular hints, body depth, joints and simplified digits are artistic.
